verdict.rationale: Justworks documents a native Xero integration that maps each pay type to Chart of Accounts lines, with department, office and employee overrides. Sync can be manual or automatic the day after processing, which puts payroll entries into the ledger. It also offers an Analytics > Custom Payroll Report, but the docs never say that report can be exported. There is no evidence of a programmatic API an agent could use to pull journal data, and the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes both returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented payroll/journal API, an explicit machine-readable export of journal data, agent-driven reconciliation, ledger targets beyond Xero, and independent corroboration.
